title: Days of Love at Seagull Villa
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: After her fiancé leaves her for her former best friend, Mayumi takes a middle-school teaching job on a remote island and moves into Seagull Villa, run by brash landlady Rin, who is raising her young niece Hinata. The two women grow close (Seven Seas blurb via AniList/MU; ANN review of vol. 1).
life_message: People heal by letting go of assumptions about each other and forming a family of their own choosing.

content.note: Family members died in an accident (backstory, ANN).
Grief and heartbreak; mostly gentle tone (ANN).

Same-sex adult romance; infidelity backstory; an older man gropes Mayumi; a middle-school girl's attraction to her half-sister (MU 'Incest as a Subplot', AniList Incest; ANN). ANN calls it fairly tame overall.
Brash landlady; not reported in detail.
Rin stops Mayumi on a bridge thinking she may jump, a misunderstanding (ANN). Single source (to verify).
